Recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to version 9.6p1 or newer, or disable ChaCha20-Poly1305 and CBC ciphers.

Recommendation: Update OpenSSH to 9.3p2 or disable remote agent forwarding.

Title: Direct Database Management Port Exposure (MYSQL)
Recommendation: Bind the MYSQL daemon strictly to localhost (127.0.0.1) or an internal private subnet; mandate VPN tunnels or application proxy access.

Title: Direct Database Management Port Exposure (REDIS)
Recommendation: Bind the REDIS daemon strictly to localhost (127.0.0.1) or an internal private subnet; mandate VPN tunnels or application proxy access.

Title: Unencrypted FTP Protocol Exposure
Recommendation: Replace legacy FTP with SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) or require FTPS with explicit TLS enforcement.

Title: Potential Vulnerability: vsftpd Denial of Service via Resource Exhaustion (CVE-2015-1849)
Recommendation: Upgrade vsftpd to 3.0.3 or implement strict per-IP connection limits.

Title: Unencrypted Telnet Remote Administration Service Exposed
Recommendation: Disable the Telnet daemon immediately and transition all remote access workflows to SSH (port 22).

Title: Administrative Service Exposed (Remote Desktop (RDP))
Recommendation: Enforce Network Level Authentication (NLA), place administration behind a dedicated VPN / bastion host, and restrict firewall access rules.
